items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. officially active for Texans debut in London vs JAX.
items.why: Rapoport confirms from Texans inactives; debut after move.
items.implication: Immediate WR role in HOU offense alongside Nico Collins.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes in new scheme; potential breakout spot.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins listed as GAME-TIME DECISION; will workout pregame to determine status after limited practice this week.
items.why: Ankle injury; only one limited practice; pregame workout planned per Rapoport corroboration.
items.implication: High uncertainty for Browns RB volume; monitor inactive list closely.
items.opportunity: If OUT, backup RBs gain significant carries/snaps.

items.text: Mike Evans GAME-TIME DECISION along with Christian Kirk.
items.why: Weekend injury summary flags as GTD.
items.implication: TB WR1 status uncertain; monitor warmups/inactives.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated role for other Bucs WRs like Chris Godwin/Egbuka.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown returning from IR and expected/likely to play vs Jets; team close to full health with Henderson also likely.
items.why: Activated/designated to return; limited practices but sources say likely active; high-ankle recovery ahead of schedule.
items.implication: Major upgrade for NE passing attack and fantasy WR2 upside; Henderson retains RB role.
items.opportunity: AJB targets/routes; full NE skill group available.

items.text: Giants expected to change RB rotation: Najee Harris larger role, Cam Skattebo downgraded after fumbles but still in mix; all four RBs active.
items.why: Sources indicate Harris expanded role post-fumbles by Skattebo.
items.implication: Skattebo snap/carry share reduced; committee more even.
items.opportunity: Najee upside; Skattebo less reliable for volume.

items.text: Chris Olave (illness) and Alvin Kamara (back) both EXPECTED TO PLAY; listed questionable but sources confirm.
items.why: Limited Friday practice; Rapoport sources say both expected despite tags.
items.implication: Saints offense at near full strength; Olave WR1 volume, Kamara RB work secure.
items.opportunity: Standard roles; reverse any prior backup hype.

items.text: Caleb Williams EXPECTED TO PLAY and planned to start for Bears after full practice week; listed questionable but starter reps taken.
items.why: Full practice; Rapoport/Schefter confirm Bears plan to start him.
items.implication: Bears passing game fully operational; boost to CHI pass catchers.

items.text: Deebo Samuel NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY.
items.why: Weekend reports summarize as not expected.
items.implication: WAS WR depth chart elevates others; targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: More routes/targets for Terry McLaurin, stefon-diggs if active.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson EXPECTED TO PLAY (ankle); likely per sources despite earlier multi-week fears.
items.why: Three limited practices; Rapoport sources say likely with AJB return.
items.implication: NE RB committee intact; Henderson retains meaningful role.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps vs Jets; handcuff value if limited.

items.text: Bucs RB Sean Tucker (quad) questionable and NOT EXPECTED to play today.
items.implication: TB backfield shifts to other options like Bucky Irving/Kenny Gainwell.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining Bucs RBs.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee in any league needing QB; will be better than expected. Not worried about Eagles skill players (Saquon etc.) with McKee starting after Hurts IR.
items.why: Hurts on IR with blood clot; McKee can play and skill group healthy.
items.implication: QB streamer and PHI skill players remain viable.
items.opportunity: McKee volume; no major dock to Barkley/Goedert/Smith.

items.text: Assuming A.J. Brown active for Patriots, starting him as WR2 wherever rostered.
items.why: Return from IR; expects immediate contribution in NE offense.
items.opportunity: High target share potential vs Jets.

items.text: No news yet on DJ Moore, Josh Palmer, Tyjae Spears; projections updated for all current news including expected players.
items.why: Responding to ETR injury summary; site projections refreshed.
items.implication: Use latest ETR numbers for DFS/season-long decisions on remaining uncertainties.

items.text: Steelers optimistic Pat Freiermuth (calf, added Sat) will play.
items.why: Calf; sources say optimistic despite late addition to report.
items.implication: PIT TE remains viable; no major dock.

items.text: Saints QB Tyler Shough has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand.
items.implication: Potential accuracy/volume impact on Saints pass catchers like Olave/Kamara.
items.opportunity: Monitor efficiency; possible slight dock to passing game.

items.text: Browns DT Mason Graham (questionable) not expected to play vs Ravens.
items.implication: Defensive impact; may affect run game slightly but secondary for fantasy.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (strong matchup for pass catchers); also Drake London, George Kittle, Kyren Williams, Javonte Williams, Rhamondre Stevenson, Brock Purdy.
items.why: Washington defense buffet for pass catchers; volume and leaking run Ds for RBs; high-scoring environments for QBs.
items.implication: Prioritize these in start/sit; Evans GTD but high upside if active.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA, Emeka Egbuka vs PIT, Kyle Pitts vs CHI, J.K. Dobbins vs SEA, Bo Nix vs SEA, Justin Herbert @ KC.
items.why: Tough matchups (SEA pass D elite), shaky QB situations, low team totals, role/usage concerns.
items.implication: Fade in start/sit; look elsewhere for volume.
items.opportunity: Poor projected snaps/targets/carries relative to alternatives.
